overview: This Senate resolution names March 6, 2026, "National Speech and Debate Education Day." It says speech and debate programs teach students communication, critical thinking, creativity and teamwork, and it credits the teachers and coaches who give extra hours to these activities. It notes that the National Speech & Debate Association and its partners lead the day's celebration. The resolution encourages schools, businesses, civic groups and the public to celebrate and promote speech and debate education. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on March 4, 2026.
for: Supporters say speech and debate builds lifelong skills in reasoning and civil disagreement that serve students in school, work and public life.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it changes no law and provides no money for school programs.
